render_rules.floor_preview: Only exact approved compiler walking-floor polygons as transient review geometry; no saved/exported duplicate floors

required_checks: All seven original fixture positions completed by actual retained geometry
All ground props, their front/rear stances, drawers and doors avoid protected routes
Every fixture backplate/hanger touches an actual source support; no floating brackets
Actual emitter-to-receiver triangle rays from every occupied deck and service zone, including self-occlusion
Guard/headroom, full acoustic cap end-return reservation, no stair/shaft intrusion
Same normal-eye camera set with source-only materials and later live normal/effects-off views
runtime_policy: No runtime edits now. Preserve existing eight-shadow-source policy; later spatial/material batches and new-asset import fidelity must be verified, not tolerance-relaxed. Authored fixture count is not simultaneous shadow-light count or target-GPU acceptance.
